title: A three-arm single blind randomised control trial of naïve medical students performing a shoulder joint clinical examination
reason: Three-arm RCT (textbook, face-to-face, online video) comparing blinded shoulder-examination scores; VARK style (self-report) tested against scores. Video-platform analytics were available but never analysed; no per-student platform indicator enters any analysis.

extraction.n_quote: Methods: Sixty-seven pre-clinical medical students naïve to large joint examination were recruited. Participants
extraction.lms_indicators: none analysed (SproutVideo access analytics described only)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: standardised clinical-examination score (max 30); VARK learning style
extraction.notes: Group effect η2 = .449 is a delivery-mode contrast, not an indicator relation. 'Preferred learning style did not affect scores (p = 0.543)' (VARK self-report). Secondary code: NOREL.
